author: NuclearDucky
body:
Name: Jedi

Weapon: Gold Sword Sharpness I Fire Aspect I

Armour: Leather chestplate, leather pants, leather boots, no helm

Abilities: If you right click, any opponent within 5 blocks will be sent back 5 blocks.(Force Push) This takes 12 seconds to recharge.
You will also have jump boost I when you right click, but only for 2 seconds.

Level: 40
